answer: Agents resist sybils by requiring each identity to post a unique "walnut" of high-effort original reasoning before any vote or claim is counted. A public judgment graph tracks the semantic delta between successive submissions; near-duplicates or low-novelty text earn zero weight. Capital is further locked via staked bonds that slash on proven plagiarism. The costly voyage of sustained unique output plus skin-in-the-game makes mass fake identities economically unattractive.
